arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m. Pacer owns effort. My jobs: (1) keep the boat computer honest: pod drift (shaft power vs boat power vs heart rate), course length (radio), (2) spot drag/weed/rudder (push_local drop within a leg, boat/shaft ratio drop) and clear it, (3) check critical power from heart rate once settled (HR climbing at steady power = above CP), (4) answer the paddler. Baseline boat/shaft ratio about 0.65 (110/170). Do not cue without evidence; save cues.

arguments.description: share of pod power that shows up as boat-model power; baseline ~0.65

arguments.message: boat power per pod watt has moved off ~0.65: pod drift, drag, blade or current
heart rate reading implausible: strap problem?

text: no cue: hard start is normal, pacer handles the ease; set plan, ratio and HR-strap watches, wake at 6 min.

arguments.text: 4 min: start went out very hard (pod 250 W for 2 min), pod reserve 10 %, boat reserve 0 %, HR 183 still climbing at pod 190 W. Ratio boat/shaft 0.65 normal. Pacer eased at 111 s; its ease can fire again ~290 s.

arguments.text: 4.6 min: paddler says legs going, close to limit. Matches data (pod reserve 5 %, HR 184 flat-ish near ceiling?). Did not cue so the pacer ease (due ~290 s) is not blocked by the cue gate.

text: no cue: paddler report matches the near-empty pod reserve; the pacer ease is due within seconds and my cue would block it.

arguments.text: 6.2 min: pod reserve reads 0 since ~5.5 min yet paddler holds pod 191 W (test CP 170) and boat 121 W (test CP 110): both instruments agree, so not pod drift. HR trend slowing 3.0 -> 1.5 bpm/min at 181-184. Hypothesis: CP ~10 % above test (shaft ~190). Test: if they hold ~190 W for 5+ more min without collapse and HR flattens, CP is higher. Watch collapse_w set. Pacer over_pace alerted only once (1.9 min).

arguments.message: pod power fell below 160 W: forced down by an empty reserve, or drift/incident

arguments.name: critical_power_shaft_w
arguments.evidence: held pod 191 W from 150-370 s with model reserve empty and no collapse; HR rise slowing (3.0 then 1.5 bpm/min) at 181-185; boat power agrees (121 vs test 110)

arguments.reason: CP check: still ~190 W without collapse? HR flat? leg 2 push

text: no cue: gathering evidence that critical power is above the test value; wake at 9.7 min to check.

arguments.name: critical_power_shaft_w
arguments.evidence: blew up at ~8.3 min (pod 191 -> 139 W, HR 187 -> 173, boat/shaft ratio still 0.63 so a real effort drop, not drag). Work above CP from start to blow-up fits CP ~178 with the test reserve 13.5 kJ, or CP 170 with ~20 kJ. Test roughly right, slightly low.

arguments.text: 8.8 min: COLLAPSE at ~8.3 min: pod 139 W, HR falling, ratio 0.63 normal, push_local -0.14 matches current against on leg 2 (push ~0.17-0.2 m/s along course). Genuine empty reserve. Pacer ease missed it (its watch errors when reserve reads 0). Risk: after recovery paddler goes back above ~180 W and blows up again; pacer ease only works before 3500 m. Watch overcook_again set.

arguments.message: back above ~186 W pod with a low reserve: second blow-up risk

text: no cue: a genuine blow-up (effort and heart rate fell together, boat ratio normal); nothing to clear or correct, recovery takes time.

arguments.text: 15.9 min: hull fit legs 1+2: share 0.656, push 0.164 m/s along course. Leg 3 (out, from 13.8 min) at share 0.656: GPS only +0.079 above still-water speed (expected +0.164): a 0.085 m/s step down near the turn (~816 s), flat within leg 3 since. HR flat 181 at 172-173 W both legs, so pod likely honest. Candidates: drag (weed caught at turn) vs current/wind weakened. Plan: clear_rudder test once the cue gate opens (~1000 s); if push_local jumps back, weed. Else leg 4 decides: drag shows a further drop on the way back too, weaker push shows smaller deficit back.

arguments.reason: send clear_rudder test (cue gate open after 996 s)

text: no cue yet: a 0.085 m/s speed step at the last turn needs a rudder-clear test, cue gate opens at 996 s, woken then.

arguments.text: 16.7 min: at 966-990 s GPS speed dipped 3.17 -> 2.99 (push_local to -0.16) then recovered; since 995 s push_local 0.20-0.21, above the 0.14 of early leg 3 and near leg 1 (0.24). Looks like something came off (paddler back-stroke? gust?). Holding the clear_rudder test; re-check at ~1045 s whether push_local stays ~0.2.

arguments.reason: did push_local stay ~0.2 after the 970-990 s dip? if back to 0.14, send clear_rudder

text: no cue: the speed deficit may have cleared itself after a short dip at 970-990 s; rechecking in 45 s before spending a back-stroke.

arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus fitted current along heading; ~+0.05 clean, ~0 with the leg-3 weed; drops when drag rises in either direction

arguments.message: boat slower per pod watt than the current explains (in this direction): weed/drag or pod change; consider clear_rudder

arguments.text: 17.6 min: CONFIRMED drag episode: leg 3 from the turn (~816 s) to ~980 s GPS ran +0.083 above still water at share 0.656 (expected ~+0.165); after a speed dip at 966-990 s it is +0.187. Something on the rudder came off by itself (or paddler cleared it). Weed can catch at a turn as a STEP, which the pacer within-leg rule misses. New watch drag_step on drag_gap = push_local - push_along (clean ~+0.05, weed ~0).

arguments.message: boat slower per pod watt than the current explains (clean ~+0.05, leg-3 weed ~-0.02): weed/drag or pod change; consider clear_rudder
